At 8 8 steps, higher-order extrapolation leaves endpoints far off-manifold and between vocabulary vertices, whereas these differences largely disappear by 32 32 steps. Implications and future work. This negative result suggests that low-NFE inference for Sigma is not limited only by the formal order of the ODE integrator. Under strong CFG, ST, and SC, the effective denoising field can be less smooth than the trajectories for which standard image-diffusion solvers were designed. In this regime, formal integration order alone is not a reliable predictor of downstream quality, and DDIM remains the most robust choice among the solvers tested. We leave exploration of more stable and efficient higher-order ODE solvers for future work.
